MEMORANDUMOFOPERATINGLEASE THIS MEMORANDUM OFOPERATINGLEASE,dated asofFebruary26,2026(this “Memorandum") among UBC LIC LLC, a New York limited liability company, having its offices at c/o Urban Builders Collaborative,LLC,334 East 110h Street,New York,New York 10029 ("Initial Landlord"), BRC LIC HOUSING DEVELOPMENT FUND CORPORATION, a NewYork not-for-profit corporation, having an address at c/o Bowery Residents’Committee, Inc., 131 West 25th Street, 12th Floor, New York, New York 10001 ("Successor Landlord"; Initial Landlord and Successor Landlord, in their respective capacities as landlord under the terms of the Lease (as hereinafter defined) shall be referred to herein collectively as “Landlord") and BOWERY RESIDENTS' COMMITTEE, INC., a New York not-for-profit corporation having an address at 131 West 25th Street, 12th Floor, New York, New York 10001 ("Tenant"). All capitalized terms used but not defined herein shall have the meanings ascribed thereto in the Lease (as defined below). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Landlord and Tenant are parties to that certain Operating Lease dated as of February 26, 2026 (the “Lease") pursuant to which Landlord leased to Tenant, that certain plot, piece and parcel of land known 38-80 11th Street, Long Island City, County of Queens, City and State of New York (Block 474, Lot 1), more particularly bounded and described as set forth in ScheduleA annexedhereto;and WHEREAS, Landlord and Tenant desire to record a memorandum summarizing certain (but not all) of the terms of the Lease. NOW, THEREFORE, Landlord and Tenant hereby agree as follows: The provisions set forth in the Lease are hereby incorporated by reference into this Memorandum. Effective Date of Lease: February 26, 2026 Commencement Date of Lease: the earlier of (i) Building Rent Commencement Date (as such term defined in the DHS Contract)or (i) the Shelter Operation Approval Date (as such term is defined in the Lease). Name andAddress of Landlord: UBC LIC LLC 334East110thStreet NewYork,NewYork10029 Attention:MatthewGross {12297624:8} 5

BRC LIC Housing Development Fund Corporation c/o Bowery Residents'Committee, Inc. 131West25thStreet,12thFloor New York,New York 10001 Name and Address of Tenant: Bowery Residents' Committee, Inc. 131 West 25th Street, 12th Floor New York,New York 10001 Description of Property: The Demised Premises and that certain building to be constructed on the Demised Premises, which shall, upon completion, contain approximately 128,000 square feet of space used as a certified homeless shelter to provide transitional housing for eligible homeless families and shall have a capacity of one hundred fifty (150) units Term of Lease: The Term of Lease is approximately forty (40) years, commencing on the Commencement Date and expiring on the earlier of (i) June 30, 2068 or (i) the date upon which this Lease is terminated pursuant to the provisions of the DHS Contract. The Lease grants no right to expand or to purchase any interest in the Demised Premises. Memorandum of Lease: This Memorandum,executed in connection with theLease, is intended to be and is entered into as a memorandum thereof solely for the purpose of recordation and the giving of notice of the Lease.This Memorandum is subject to all of the terms, conditions and provisions of the Lease and shall not be construed to vary or otherwise affect such terms, conditions and provisions or the rights and obligations of the parties thereto.In the event of any conflict between the terms, conditions and provisions of the Lease and this Memorandum, the terms conditions and provisions of the Lease shall control. This Memorandum may be executed in counterparts. No Effect on Lease. This Memorandum is prepared, signed and acknowledged solely for recording purposes under New York Law. The purpose of this Memorandum is to give notice of the existence of the tenancy created by the Lease; and shall not be construed to vary or otherwise affect the rights or obligations of the parties under theLease as it may be amended. Each of Landlord and Tenant has rights, duties, and obligations (and conditions to its rights) under the Lease that are not stated in this Memorandum.Ifthe Lease and this Memorandum conflict, the Lease governs. Nothing in this {12297624:8} 6

Memorandum constitutes any representation or warranty by either party. To the extent, if any, that the Lease limits the liabilityof either Landlord or Tenant,suchlimitation shall apply with the same force and effect to any liability of Landlord or Tenant under this Memorandum. Successors and Assigns: TheLeaseand thisMemorandumshallbind andbenefit the parties and their successors and assigns. This shall not limit any restriction on assignment or other transfer permitted under the terms of the Lease. Termination ofthisMemorandum: ThisMemorandumshall automatically terminate andbe of no force or effect upon the expiration or any earlier termination of the Lease. Counterparts: This Memorandum may be executed in counterparts each of which shall be deemed anoriginal and all ofwhich together shall be deemed one and the same instrument. Electronic PDF or facsimile signatures shall be accepted as originals. [SIGNATUREPAGEFOLLOWS] {12297624:8}
